high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website deccanherald.com. The content of the article discusses the creation of a molecule that required special bonding between boron and nitrogen atoms at -78°C in an oxygen-controlled environment. The scientists made the molecule rigid and stable to ensure it glows brightly without fading quickly. The team hopes to enhance the glow further for potential use in medical imaging or wearable devices.
